scope: Independent host behavior review of the package-private Android owner decision core; no native/runtime, effect-runner or public-routing qualification.
basis: Producer API-only message received before source access: OwnerLifecycleV2, opaque Token, WindowFacts, Decision, Snapshot, ThreadCheck and entry method signatures.
method: Compile the exact candidate Java source with an independently authored package-peer harness using official javac --release 17 -Xlint:all -Werror -proc:none and empty class/source paths. Exercise actual decisions, tokens and state with manual event delivery. Do not execute or import producer tests or collectors. Use bounded children and retain failure/cleanup receipts.

controls.case: Each readiness prerequisite missing in isolation; repeated ready notifications and a stale queued drain.
controls.expect: No operation while unready or automatic polling; only matching ready drain opens exactly once.

controls.case: Invalidations during initial open, then during refresh, plus a burst before a drain.
controls.expect: At most one queued drain, no concurrent operations, later dirty epoch survives earlier completion and yields one follow-up refresh.

controls.case: Destroy/detach/window replacement/window loss while open is executing; matching completion returns an acquired resource.
controls.expect: Terminal fence closes before completion; matching resource is closed once, no presentation is published, duplicate completion cannot close another resource.

controls.case: Deliver completion from another owner, stale operation, or duplicate completion with a foreign resource before/after retirement.
controls.expect: No ownership adoption/replacement, foreign close, publication, dirty clearing or reopening.

controls.case: Matching open failure supplies a resource; registration failure and cleanup failures use distinct identities.
controls.expect: Terminal first; ordered seal/cancel/unregister and one owned close; primary and bounded secondary diagnostics preserve identity; no retry.

controls.case: Close during refresh or input, deliver a queued callback whose cancellation was ineffective, then complete the operation.
controls.expect: No post-retirement work/publication; close is deferred until matching operation returns and occurs once.

controls.case: Use obsolete presentation after invalidation and after successful refresh, stale lifetime from another owner, and reentrant input during an operation.
controls.expect: All are denied; current clean foreground/focused owner admits at most one immediate dispatch, with no replay or event queue.
No new owner/session decision; resume/configuration require fresh environment work before admission; focus is not a prerequisite for initial open.

controls.case: Live owner becomes temporarily zero-sized or lacks insets and then becomes ready.
controls.expect: Remains dirty with input closed, no polling/refresh while unready, one refresh after a real readiness notification.

controls.case: Seed epoch at the maximum; invalidate then deliver any stale callbacks.
controls.expect: Terminal exhaustion, no wrap or reused token identity, no further work.

controls.case: Invoke every entry, including getters, predicates, stale completions and cleanup, with an injected wrong-thread check.
controls.expect: Reject before any observable state or decision change; injected checker is trusted nonreentrant.

controls.case: Keep an operation indefinitely outstanding after retirement.
controls.expect: No false cleanup completion or close while operation remains outstanding; receipt labels actual reclamation pending.

controls.case: Exercise long bounded repeated invalidation/refresh cycles and terminal cleanup reporting.
controls.expect: No production history collection, bounded per-call decisions and retained token/failure slots; test recorder may retain history independently.

controls.case: Construct a fresh owner after retiring an old one; cross-deliver lifetimes/drains/completions.
controls.expect: Independent token identity and state; old work cannot affect new owner; no state-restoration claim.

controls.case: Matching completion claims committed success without an owned resource, refresh/input tries to replace owned resource, or unknown failure occurs.
controls.expect: Fail closed or reject without foreign-resource ownership; never enter live with unowned coordinator or publish an unknown outcome.

limits: Black-box host decisions cannot prove Android listener cleanup, native gate sealing, JNI behavior, actual main-Looper identity or commit/finish safety.
Every retained-state bound claim additionally requires focused source review; it is not inferred solely from long-run functional tests.
Source-pair profile 1 and public V1 remain unchanged; API 28-35 and unsupported environment behavior remain pending.
